ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no driver-side action (driver never tapped "I'm Here").
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the only statement is the driver's neutral "I was on my way when the rider cancelled" [F8]; no chat messages exist [F7]; no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation appears, so no escalation under SAFE-1/SAFE-2. safety_concern = none.

This is a rider-cancelled (immediate) booking, so the fee's validity runs through NS-0 → NS-4. The cancellation was made 1 min 40 s after matching [F2] — within Ryde's 3-minute free-cancellation window (≤ 3:00). NS-4 is explicit: "All cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable." The $6.61 fee is therefore not chargeable and must be returned in full: refund_full, $6.61.

The recorded driver-side evidence is consistent with this and shows no ground for the fee: the driver never came within 200 m of the pickup (closest 2138 m at the moment of cancellation [F1]), arrival was never recorded [F3], and no "I'm Here" tap or automatic arrival exists [F4]. Surge was 1.0× [F6]; traffic was a mid-band speed record on Eu Tong Sen Street with no incidents [F9][F10]; weather fair [F11]. None of this creates any chargeable item.

NS-8 (driver late vs ETA) is not cited: Ryde has no such rule and the file carries no ETA field, so the rider's "driver was nowhere near" is not the basis of the refund — NS-4's 3-minute rule alone is. NS-1/NS-2 are not reached, because the driver did not cancel on a no-show basis and never pressed "I'm Here", so the flag_account trigger in NS-2 (tap while GPS shows away from pickup) does not apply. RD-6 is not triggered: no route deviation was upheld and the driver's profile shows 0 upheld disputes in 90 days [F13]. The rider's 2 upheld no-show disputes [F12] are noted but never decide this case.

Evidence status sufficient: the GPS approach distance, the acceptance timestamp and the cancellation timestamp settle every element NS-4 needs; no record is missing.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's written statement that he 'was on his way' [F8] is an unrecorded claim and carries no weight against the system records [F1][F3][F4]; in any event it does not affect NS-4, which turns only on the time between matching and the rider's cancellation.

The rider's ground that the driver was nowhere near does not itself create a fee waiver: Ryde has no ETA-lateness free-cancellation rule (NS-8 is informational only) and no ETA field exists in the file. The fee is refunded under NS-4's 3-minute rule instead.
